metadata.title: Safety Tips | Open Market
metadata.description: Stay safe when buying and selling on Open Market.

safety.title: Safety Tips
safety.intro: At Open Market, your safety is our top priority. While most transactions go smoothly, it's important to stay vigilant. Here are some guidelines to help you buy and sell safely.
safety.tip1Body: Always arrange to meet in a busy, public location like a coffee shop, shopping mall, or police station "safe exchange zone". Avoid meeting at your home or a secluded area, especially for high-value items.
safety.tip2Body: If possible, bring a friend or family member with you to the exchange. There is safety in numbers. If you must go alone, let someone know where you are going and who you are meeting.
safety.tip3Body: Examine the item thoroughly before handing over any money. Ensure it matches the description and works as expected. Don't be pressured into a quick sale.
safety.tip4Body: Unlike other platforms, Open Market connects you to real Atmosphere profiles. Click the seller's handle to see their activity. Do they have followers? Have they been active for a while? Reputation is your best safety tool.
safety.reportBody: If you encounter a suspicious listing or user, please report it to us immediately using the "Report Listing" feature or contacting us directly.

metadata.title: Seller Guide | Open Market
metadata.description: Best practices for creating listings that sell quickly on Open Market.

sellerGuide.title: Seller Guide
sellerGuide.intro: Ready to declutter and earn some extra cash? Follow these best practices to create listings that attract buyers and sell quickly on Open Market.
sellerGuide.photosTip2: Take photos from multiple angles (front, back, sides).
sellerGuide.photosTip3: Show any defects or wear honestly.
sellerGuide.descTip1: Be descriptive in your title (brand, model, size).
sellerGuide.descTip3: Mention why you are selling it.
sellerGuide.descTip4: Use keywords buyers might search for.
sellerGuide.priceTip1: Research similar items to see what they sold for.
sellerGuide.priceTip2: Be willing to negotiate reasonable offers.
sellerGuide.priceTip3: Consider pricing slightly lower for a quick sale.
sellerGuide.priceTip4: Mark items as "Free" if you just want them gone!
sellerGuide.commTip1: Respond to messages as quickly as you can.
sellerGuide.commTip3: Clearly state your availability for meeting up.
sellerGuide.commTip4: Mark items as "Sold" immediately after the sale.
sellerGuide.ctaBody: Join our community of buyers and sellers today. It's free, decentralized, and built on the open web.
